_about: Fights that a wipe does not end the game for (story/fight_retry.gd). Each rule names the fights it covers: `fights` (ids) and/or `prefix` (an id prefix, limited to `locations` when that is given). On a wipe the party rises with every Hit Point and power back, the Narrator says the first of `keys` that exists ({fight} is the encounter id), and the fight begins again: `restart` names a different entry to begin (default: the same one); `spawns` (location id to spawn names, the first one the map has) puts the party back at that entry first; without it the party stays where it stands. `count_flag` counts the retries.
